spans.s: (III)--an oblation; often comes with kavyam; a compound word, havyakavyam.
(IV)--a deva of the Harita group. वा. १००. ८८.
(V)--one of the ten branches of सुपारा group of devas. वा. १००. ९४.
(II)--a son of अन्तर्धान and शिखण्डिनि; wife, आग्नेयी-Dhis2an2a1; had six sons. Br. II ३७. २३-4; वा. ६३. २२, २३; Vi. I. १
(III)--a son of पृथु married धिषणा and got a number of sons; attained heaven by tapas.
--a daughter of Kardama married to Pulastya. Father of Agastya and विश्रवस्. भा. III. २४. २२;
--one of the ten branches of the सुपार group of devas. वा. १००. ९४.
(I)--a son of Angiras; a sage of the चाक्षुष epoch. भा.
(II)--a sage of the tenth epoch of Manu. भा. VIII. १३. २१-22; Vi.
(III)--a sage of the चाक्षुष epoch. Vi.
(IV)--a sage of the XI epoch of Manu. Vi.
--पितृस्, sons of Angiras who live in the world of मरीचिगर्भ; lords of those who perform तीर्थ s4ra1ddhas and of क्षत्रियस्; their mind-born daughter, यशोदा, wife of अम्शुमान्. M. १५. १६; १०२. २०.
--a sage of the second सावर्ण epoch. Br.
(II)--(काश्यप) a sage of the epoch of III सावर्ण. Br.
(III)--wife कुहू, abandoned him for Soma. M. २३. २५.

(I)--one of the ten sons of कर्दमा and Sva- yambhu and king of शाकद्वीप and had seven sons, Jalada, कुमार, सुकुमार, Manivaha, Kurumottara, मोदाल्ल and महाद्रुङ्ग, the founders respectively of seven kingdoms bearing their names; these are demons of the शाकद्वीप. Br. II. ११. २३; १३. १०४; १४. 9-२१; वा. ३१. १८; ३३. 9, १६, २०;
(II)--a god of आद्य group. Br. II. ३६. ६९.
--सहरक्ष mantras in the यज्ञ to keep out Asuras; Havyas for devas. वा. ९७. २६.
(I)--a son of Suci Agni; the agni of devas. Br. II. १२. 5. वा. २९. 4, 5.
(II)--one of the ten kalas energising Agni. Br. IV. ३५. ८३.
(II)--(आत्रेय) a sage of the Rohita epoch. Br.
(IV)--the name of the ninth kalpa. वा. २१. ३१; २४. १६२.
--another name for असम्सृष्ट located at what is known as शामित्र. वा. २९. २२.
